availability: Free · needs a Ledge with LedgeKit 0.13 · macOS 14 or later
description: Notes gives you a page of your own in the open notch: your notes in a list, and a Markdown editor to write them, saved as you type. Headings, bold, italic, lists and checklists are styled as you write, and a click ticks a checkbox. Notes are plain Markdown files that stay on this Mac, in the folder Ledge keeps for the add-on; a deleted note goes to the Trash. Copy puts a note on your clipboard. Notes doesn't sync, search inside notes or read Apple Notes. Screenshots show sample notes.
